fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point where the truck driveway leaves Eagle Ridge Dr. The entrance from the public road is an open paved driveway directly into the lot; satellite at z19 and three Street-View headings along Eagle Ridge Dr show no gate structure and no perimeter fence line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance. No 1-3-vehicle-footprint structure beside the truck lane in any imagery.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all (remoteGs requires a gate present).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck court on the west side between the drop yard and the dock apron gives ample interior holding room before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The internal truck approach from Eagle Ridge Dr loops several hundred feet to the west-side docks; easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Long bank of drop trailers parked without tractors along the west yard, north of the dock apron, distinct from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~44 estimate; doors run nearly the full length of the west building face, partly shadowed/occluded by backed-in trailers in overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC plus a separate smaller building at the SW corner (the remote truck-maintenance facility named in UNFI/ESI project descriptions).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; no track visible adjacent.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park in Prescott WI (Pierce County), open farm fields on the north and east property lines; rural per rubric.
